thought.text: Ketemu: **LightVela** = platform agen AI cloud (bukan penyedia LLM). Ada halaman **Docs**. Saya baca, khusus soal konfigurasi model custom.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 25 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://lightvela.ai" | grep -oE 'href="[^"]*(doc|doc-|/docs)[^"]*"' | sort -u | head -20; echo "=== coba /docs ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 -L "https://lightvela.ai/docs"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 -L "https://lightvela.ai/doc"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 25 -A \"Mozilla/5.0\" \"https://lightvela.ai\" | grep -oE 'href=\"[^\"]*(doc|doc-|/docs)[^\"]*\"' | sort -u | head -20; echo \"=== coba /docs ===\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" --max-time 20 -L \"https://lightvela.ai/docs\"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" --max-time 20 -L \"https://lightvela.ai/doc\"", "summary": "Find LightVela docs URLs", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 150}
